subject: Compact onboarding cadence — tradeoffs for compressed MSA walkthrough
messages:
From: Alex Tran <alex.tran@cloudspire.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@cloudspire.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: onboarding cadence — compressed windows request

Hi Marissa,

We can only offer three short availability windows next week (Americas-only): Tue 8/25 10–11am PT, Wed 8/26 2–3pm PT, or Thu 8/27 4–5pm PT. Our procurement/legal team is stretched and asked if we can combine the MSA redline walk and the technical onboarding checkpoint into a single two-hour block to minimize stakeholder time.

They also flagged two items they need covered live: (1) data residency questions, (2) evidence for SOC 2 controls. If we compress, can Redwood run through the redlines first with Ben on, then do the onboarding run faster? If Ben is on the call we can triage redlines in real-time.

Let me know which of those three windows can work for you — we can confirm with our legal alias after.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Tran
Sr. IT Procurement, CloudSpire Health

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Tran <alex.tran@cloudspire.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: onboarding cadence — compressed windows request

Alex — thanks for the clear options and the priorities. We can accommodate a compressed session but want to set expectations up front so the time is productive:

- Plan: first 45–60 minutes focused on MSA redline triage (Ben takes point on legal Qs).
- Then 45–60 minutes for the onboarding checkpoint (Kim runs the technical walkthrough and shows the preflight checklist).
- If we hit open security evidence requests, we’ll note follow-ups and deliverables (we won’t try to produce artifact bundles live).

Of your three windows, Wed 8/26 2–3pm PT is our preferred slot because Kimberly has availability to run the demo right after the legal segment. Can you confirm that works for your legal alias? If they need an earlier or later start we can extend to a 2-hour block on Thu 8/27 4–6pm PT instead.

I’m attaching the latest MSA redlines (v3) so Ben can pre-scan and mark must-haves vs negotiables — will save time during the triage. Also attaching our onboarding checklist for the tech portion.

Attachments:
- MSA-redlines-v3.docx (docx)
- onboard-checklist.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — I’ll hold Wed 2pm tentatively until I hear back.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0149

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Alex Tran <alex.tran@cloudspire.com>, legal@cloudspire.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: onboarding cadence — compressed windows request

Marissa — thanks for sharing the materials. Quick notes after a fast pass of MSA-redlines-v3.docx:

- Data residency: we can confirm EU/AZ tenant options are possible for certain deployments; for hosted API we have region controls and can document the retention pattern.
- SOC 2 evidence: I’ll bring the controls list and the SOC 2 attestation summary to the triage. For detailed logs/audit, we’ll capture follow-up action items and a delivery timeline (typically 3 business days for a prepared bundle).
- Redlines: there are three clauses I’d like to flag as needing internal escalation if CloudSpire insists (liability cap tweaks, indemnity carve-outs, and a narrower SLA exception). We should surface those early.

I’m available Wed 8/26 2–3pm PT and can be remote from 1:45 to prep. If they need a full two-hour window Thu 4–6pm PT that also works for me.

Ben Carter
Counsel, Contracting | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Alex Tran <alex.tran@cloudspire.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, legal@cloudspire.com
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: onboarding cadence — compressed windows request

Marissa / Ben / Kimberly — confirmed. Our legal alias is good for Wed 8/26 2–3pm PT but asks we keep a 30-minute buffer after for internal debrief. If Redwood prefers, we’ll extend to Thu 8/27 4–6pm PT as the full two-hour working session.

Given Ben’s flags, they prefer we try Wed 2–3pm as the first pass (redlines + quick run), and then do a follow-up working session Thu 4–6pm if the redlines need deeper negotiation. That sequence sounds workable to us.

I’ll accept the tentative Wed calendar invite and send a separate invite for Thu as a placeholder. Attaching our procurement intake notes so you can see the high-level priorities.

Attachment: cloudspire-procurement-notes.txt (text)

Alex
